saved-event.why: The shim's onSaved callback in new-item.js calls self.trigger('saved', m), so ItemsPage's listenTo handler still receives the model.

wait-true.why: NewItemForm calls collection.create(..., { wait: true }) on the collection passed in from the shim, which is the shared app.items.

navigate.why: The shim's onSaved callback calls Backbone.history.navigate('items/' + m.id, { trigger: true }) after triggering 'saved', as the original did.

server-errors.why:
The error handler sets the message to responseJSON.errors.join(', ') when errors is an array, and shows it in

.

unmount.why: ItemsPage.remove calls form.remove(), and the shim's remove() calls this.mounted.unmount() before the Backbone remove.

no-silent-changes.why: The summary flags the extra wrapper div, the missing bundler setup, form values persisting after save and render() becoming a no-op, and the added dev dependencies. The qty coercion and error text are unchanged in effect.
